subject: general
question: A sum becomes Rs. 12960 in 2 years at the rate of 4 percent per annum on simple interest. What is the sum?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Simple Interest percentage for 2 years = 4% × 2 = 8%

Amount percentage = Principal (100%) + Interest (8%) = 108%

Given, 108% → Rs. 12960

100% → 12960 × (100 ÷ 108) = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = Rs. 12960

Time (T) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 4% per annum

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 
 Principal
 
 
 Amount
 
 
• 
 

 
 Time = 2 years
 Rate = 4% p.a.
 + SI (8% of P)
 
 100%
 108% = Rs. 12960

**Calculations:**

⇒ Amount = P + (P × 4 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 12960 = P + (8P ÷ 100)

⇒ 12960 = 108P ÷ 100

⇒ P = (12960 × 100) ÷ 108

⇒ P = 120 × 100

⇒ P = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest (CI)

When interest is compounded annually, Amount = P(1 + R/100)T.

Difference between CI and SI (2 years)

For a sum P at R% per annum for 2 years, Difference (D) = P × (R/100)².

Sum becoming n times

If a sum becomes 'n' times of itself at SI in 'T' years, Rate = (n − 1) × 100 ÷ T.
